manual.title: Add Dynaframe
manual.description: IP address or hostname of the frame. If the frame is protected by the Web Login plugin, create an API key on its Web Login page and enter it here; switch on HTTPS if the frame uses it (recommended, otherwise the key travels unencrypted).

init.title: Options
init.description:
Auto-add: when on, every Dynaframe found on the network is set up without confirmation; deleted frames are moved to "Ignored". Applies to all frames.

Web Login for this frame: API key saved: {key_state}. Leave the key field empty to keep it, enter - to remove it. Pinned certificate (SHA-256): {fingerprint}
